arrival.from: Google Flow, generated from the outside walk's last frame
arrival.used: every 2nd frame from 2 to 54, cropped 6 % and colour-matched to that frame (gain R 1.069 G 1.115 B 1.166), 832x480 upscaled to 1280x720

arrival2.from: Google Flow, generated from the first Flow clip's last good frame
arrival2.used: 31 frames picked by visual change (even walking pace), aligned (crop 2 %, shift -4 px) and colour-matched to the first clip, then the same crop/grade as the first
